### Jesus’ First Appearance
Author: Charles F. Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/jesus-first-appearance
Passage: Isaiah 25:1
Points:
- Biblical events that appear confusing or coincidental are part of God's deliberate redemptive plan.
- The Lord sovereignly orchestrates human rulers and history to fulfill His ancient promises.
- Christ's lowly birth in a stable was an intentional divine design rather than an unfortunate accident.
- Believers facing difficult circumstances can trust that God knows all things and works with good purpose.
